identity.title: VM0047 Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation, v1.1

rules.title: ARR activity eligibility
rules.logic: Project activities must establish, increase or restore vegetative cover in non-forest areas; area-based activities may enhance stocks in existing forest cover only where the forest has not been managed for wood products in the previous ten years.

rules.title: Area-based leakage module
rules.logic: Area-based projects apply VMD0054 to quantify leakage.

rules.title: Census approach core conditions
rules.logic: Census-based projects use direct planting, max 50 planting units/ha, complete census at t=0, project-method additionality/baseline, and no leakage deduction where land use is maintained.

rules.title: Mutually exclusive approach applicability
rules.logic: Each project activity instance must fully meet either area-based or census-based applicability; mixed projects require clearly separated instances with at least a 10 m buffer.

rules.title: General applicability conditions
rules.logic: All projects must increase vegetative cover, keep mixed approaches non-overlapping, fix the quantification approach for the crediting period, document the earliest start-date trigger, and use a multiple-project-activity design on organic soils/wetlands.

rules.title: Area-based t0 before site preparation
rules.logic: Where site preparation triggers the start date, t=0 estimates for all significant pools must be established before preparation and no more than two years before start; remote sensing is limited to pre-existing woody biomass if plots were unavailable.

rules.title: Remote sensing t0 limitation
rules.logic: Remote sensing may establish t=0 only for pre-existing above- and belowground woody biomass; disturbed significant pools without t=0 measurement make the project ineligible unless conservatively excludable.

rules.title: Area-based t0 after land-use-change start
rules.logic: Where start is a land-use-change date or preparation did not significantly reduce monitored pools, t=0 estimates must be established within two years after start, using plot sampling for all significant pools and evidence that preparation did not significantly reduce them.

rules.title: Leakage not de minimis
rules.logic: Area-based leakage must be monitored and quantified using VMD0054 and must not be assumed de minimis.

rules.title: Census planting, land use, density and census
rules.logic: Census-based activities must use direct planting, maintain pre-project land use, stay at or below 50 planting units/ha with proportional scaling, and establish N by complete census at t=0.

rules.title: Census replanting cap
rules.logic: Dead planting units may be replanted provided N does not exceed 50 live project planting units per hectare.

rules.title: Planting-unit identification
rules.logic: Each census planting unit must be identifiable by GPS spacing at least equal to positional accuracy or by a durable unique physical marker.

rules.title: Missing unit mortality assumption
rules.logic: A planting unit that cannot be located at monitoring is conservatively assumed dead.

rules.title: Census land eligibility
rules.logic: Census activity must occur in areas with less than 10% pre-existing woody cover and/or qualifying continuous cropping, settlements or other lands.

rules.title: Project soil-disturbance limits
rules.logic: Project-related soil disturbance is permitted at planting; localized planting disturbance may exceed 25 cm, but soil inversion must not exceed 25 cm and may occur only once in the crediting period.

rules.title: Area-based exclusions
rules.logic: Area-based projects are ineligible on recently managed forest, where clearing involves timber harvest or native-ecosystem degradation, or where planting fewer than 50 units/ha could use census-based approach.

rules.title: Census-based exclusions
rules.logic: Census projects are ineligible where similar-purpose woody biomass was removed in the prior 10 years or project soil inversion exceeds 25 cm.

rules.title: Non-overlap and significance test
rules.logic: Mixed approaches must have non-overlapping accounting boundaries and Appendix 2 must be applied to test significance of optional pools and GHG sources.

rules.title: Area-based carbon-pool inclusion
rules.logic: Above- and belowground woody biomass are mandatory; optional pools become mandatory where project activity significantly reduces them or specified disturbance/harvesting conditions apply; harvested wood products are excluded.

rules.title: Census accounting boundary and pools
rules.logic: Each census planting unit has a 10 m radius accounting buffer; buffers may overlap within an instance but not another instance; only above- and belowground woody biomass are included.

rules.title: GHG-source inclusion
rules.logic: Project CH4 and N2O from biomass burning and N2O from nitrogen fertilizer may be significant and are included; baseline sources and fossil-fuel burning are conservatively excluded or de minimis as specified.

rules.title: Area-based baseline
rules.logic: Area-based baseline is set using a performance benchmark derived from representative control plots under Appendix 1.

rules.title: Census zero baseline
rules.logic: Where census criteria are met, absence of ARR without project intervention may be assumed and the crediting baseline is zero.

rules.title: Additionality method by approach
rules.logic: Area-based projects use a performance method and census-based projects use a project method to demonstrate additionality.

rules.title: Area-based additionality demonstrations
rules.logic: Area-based projects must demonstrate regulatory surplus, performance benchmark and investment analysis, except the investment-analysis exception where no non-carbon revenue or financial incentive exists.

rules.title: Census additionality demonstrations
rules.logic: Census-based projects must demonstrate regulatory surplus, investment analysis and common practice; investment analysis is always required.

rules.title: Regulatory surplus dependency
rules.logic: Regulatory surplus must follow the most recent VCS Methodology Requirements.

rules.title: Performance benchmark additionality
rules.logic: Area-based projects establish the Appendix 1 benchmark; validation uses an ex-ante expected difference and each verification reassesses additionality using the Appendix 1 Z test.

rules.title: Investment analysis dependency
rules.logic: Investment analysis must use benchmark or investment-comparison analysis and Step 3 of the most recent VT0008 Additionality Assessment.

rules.title: Common-practice procedure
rules.logic: Census common-practice analysis must define activity, domain and adopter class, identify essential distinctions, survey representative similar landowners within five years of start, and calculate adoption without carbon finance.

rules.title: Common-practice threshold
rules.logic: Adoption below 15% is not common practice; adoption equal to or above 15% is common practice and the activity is not additional.

rules.title: Alternative common-practice evidence
rules.logic: Public government data, peer-reviewed literature or independent industry research collected within five years of start may substitute for survey evidence when relevant and conservatively non-discriminating regarding carbon finance.

rules.title: Area baseline quantification
rules.logic: Area-based baseline stock changes are accounted by applying the performance benchmark to estimated removals.

rules.title: Census baseline stock change
rules.logic: Census baseline stock change is zero because the baseline has no project planting units.

rules.title: Pre-existing woody biomass t0 methods
rules.logic: Area-based pre-existing woody biomass requires t=0 via preferred pre-preparation plots, eligible post-start plots, or a qualifying remote-sensing estimate using specified model, confidence-bound, correlation and spatial-resolution conditions.

rules.title: Pre-existing biomass removal conditions
rules.logic: Removal during site preparation requires a t=0 estimate, waste/no-commercial-value status, and no clearing or harvesting of natural forest, native tree species or commercially viable timber.

rules.title: Dead-wood t0 and disturbance accounting
rules.logic: Dead wood t=0 must be measured by plots before disturbance and no more than two years before start; project disturbance or removal must be quantified by stock difference.

rules.title: Delayed census biomass measurement
rules.logic: If first carbon-stock measurement occurs after t=0, that measurement replaces t=0 for stock-change calculations and change before it is zero; project start remains t=0 for other purposes.

rules.title: Complete census monitoring
rules.logic: Census woody biomass scales sampled per-unit biomass by N adjusted for mortality; monitoring of the complete census is required.

rules.title: Excluded census pools
rules.logic: Non-woody biomass, dead wood, litter and SOC are not applicable in census-based project carbon-stock quantification.

rules.title: Census fertilizer equations
rules.logic: Census nitrogen-fertilizer N2O emissions use Equations 15-21 from §8.2.2.2.

rules.title: Leakage by approach
rules.logic: Area-based leakage uses the most recent VMD0054; census leakage LKt is zero because pre-project production is maintained and density limits avoid displacement.

rules.title: Uncertainty scope
rules.logic: Sampling uncertainty is quantified and accounted; measurement error is handled via QA/QC; burning and fertilizer parameter uncertainty is set to zero under conservative parameters.

rules.title: Area uncertainty
rules.logic: Area-based projects must use measurement-appropriate standard methods for uncertainty for each included pool; Equation 28 applies when inventory method is maintained.

rules.title: Changed sampling uncertainty
rules.logic: Where area-based projects switch inventory approaches, combined uncertainty must follow Appendix 3.

rules.title: Census uncertainty
rules.logic: Census uncertainty propagates uncertainty in mortality-adjusted population and mean woody biomass using Equations 29-31.

rules.title: 100% confidence-width crediting stop
rules.logic: For either approach, CRt is zero where the half-width of the two-sided 90% confidence interval exceeds 100% of the removal estimate.

rules.title: Mixed-approach removals
rules.logic: Mixed-project removals equal the sum of independently calculated area- and census-based removals over non-overlapping areas.

rules.title: Harvesting LTA requirement
rules.logic: Projects with harvesting must follow the most recent VCS Standard long-term-average requirement as an upper limit on calculated removals.

rules.title: Annualization
rules.logic: Annualized removals equal monitoring-interval removals divided by interval length.

rules.title: Ex-ante estimation requirements
rules.logic: Project description must include ex-ante removals for the crediting period using conservative growth and yield inputs, modeled harvest or management, at least 10% uncertainty deduction, approach-specific equations and baselines, and area-based benchmark forecasting.

rules.title: Project-area evidence
rules.logic: Project area A is calculated from GIS; imagery or GIS must be georegistered and each discrete project area uniquely identified.

rules.title: Root-to-shoot ratio hierarchy
rules.logic: R must follow the specified descending hierarchy by forest type/ecoregion or species/genus/family, with global values validated against direct measurements in the same ecoregion or life-zone.

rules.title: Default emission parameters
rules.logic: GWP uses the most recent IPCC assessment; nitrogen emission factors and fractions use the specified IPCC 2019 values.

rules.title: Initial population record
rules.logic: N is established by complete census and each planting-unit record must include unique ID, georeferenced location, year planted and species.

rules.title: Area woody-biomass monitoring
rules.logic: Aboveground woody biomass must use representative unbiased plot sampling, documented QA/QC, fixed size thresholds and appropriately selected or validated allometry; VT0005 does not apply.

rules.title: Non-woody biomass monitoring
rules.logic: Non-woody biomass uses representative plot sampling, minimum/maximum seasonal samples or conservative minimum-stock sampling, at least every five years.

rules.title: Dead-wood monitoring
rules.logic: Standing and lying dead wood require unbiased representative sampling, fixed thresholds, documented protocols, appropriate volume and density methods and monitoring at least every five years.

rules.title: Litter monitoring
rules.logic: Litter uses destructive fixed-frame sampling with dry-mass determination; monitoring occurs at t=0 and at least every five years.

rules.title: SOC monitoring
rules.logic: SOC requires representative stratified sampling to at least 30 cm, matched SOC and bulk-density measurement, equivalent-soil-mass remeasurement, documented protocols and required QA/QC; frequency may not be less than 10 years under the stated low-disturbance conditions.

rules.title: Fertilizer monitoring evidence
rules.logic: Fertilizer mass and content must be monitored at least every five years or before a more frequent verification and quantitative management information must be supported by documentary evidence.

rules.title: Sampled planting-unit record
rules.logic: Randomized sampling from N establishes nt and each sampled-unit record includes unique ID, georeference, year planted and species.

rules.title: Mortality monitoring
rules.logic: Mortality is determined by complete re-enumeration or representative sampling; a unit is dead where green vascular tissue and leaves are absent or the unit cannot be relocated.

rules.title: Census per-unit biomass monitoring
rules.logic: Per-unit biomass requires representative sampling from N, documented QA/QC, fixed thresholds, validated allometry and at least five-year monitoring; live units below the predetermined size threshold receive zero biomass but remain in the sample.

rules.title: Census burned-unit monitoring
rules.logic: Visibly burned and killed planting units are tallied by representative sampling with documented protocols at least every five years.

rules.title: Standard-error estimation
rules.logic: SEp,t must use representative unbiased estimators appropriate to the sample design with documented error checking and outlier procedures.

rules.title: Monitoring-plan minimum content
rules.logic: The monitoring plan must specify approach, tasks, accounting boundaries, measured parameters, collection techniques and sample design, frequencies, QA/QC, electronic archiving, roles, remote-sensing schedule and stocking-index derivation.

rules.title: Monitoring-data retention
rules.logic: All monitoring and QA/QC data must be electronically archived for at least two years after the end of the last project crediting period.

rules.title: Area plot database
rules.logic: Area-based projects must maintain a database with stocking-index derivation, project and control plot IDs, locations, configuration, time series and weights, plus remote-sensing datasets and timestamps.

rules.title: Performance-method applicability
rules.logic: Appendix 1 applies only where Section 4 applicability is met, project activities produce spatially delineable vegetative cover, and the performance benchmark is updated at each verification or every five years, whichever occurs first.

rules.title: Dynamic control-plot baseline
rules.logic: The performance-method baseline is business-as-usual aboveground biomass growth observed on representative remotely sensed control plots outside registered AFOLU project areas and is re-established at each verification using the updated performance benchmark.

rules.title: Benchmark granularity and ex-ante estimate
rules.logic: A performance benchmark is developed per project area, or per annual cohort for grouped projects; an ex-ante estimate must use control-plot stocking indices from historic t=-10 to t=0 and project slope from the Section 8.7 growth-and-yield procedure.

rules.title: Remote sensing is relative-stock evidence
rules.logic: For the performance benchmark, remote sensing is used to estimate relative stock change between project and control plots rather than to directly estimate reportable carbon stocks; removal accounting remains dependent on direct field measurement under Section 8.

rules.title: Match-quality threshold
rules.logic: Overall project/control matching is valid only where SDM for every matching covariate is less than or equal to 0.25; otherwise donor-pool radius or k are iteratively adjusted.

rules.title: Control-plot invalidation and replacement
rules.logic: At monitoring, invalid controls are removed, replacements drawn from the donor pool and control weights recalculated to sum to 1.

rules.title: Benchmark time-series minimum sample
rules.logic: Benchmark time series must include t=0 and t plus prior verifications; matched sets missing time-t SI are excluded; at least 30 project plots are required.

rules.title: Z-test significance threshold
rules.logic: Absolute Z equal to or above 1.96 means project and control stocking-index slopes are significantly different.

rules.title: Performance benchmark pathway
rules.logic: If absolute Z is below 1.96 PBt is 1; if absolute Z is at least 1.96 PBt is calculated by Equation A8; an insignificant or negative control slope is set to zero.

rules.title: Benchmark procedure documentation
rules.logic: All benchmark-establishment steps and all project/control plot locations must be documented in the project description and monitoring plan sufficiently to be repeated and validated.

rules.title: Project-plot construction and sampling
rules.logic: For each annual cohort, project plots must be equal-sized contiguous non-overlapping units of 0.01-10 ha with at least 75% inside the project boundary, and at least 30 representative project plots must be randomly sampled overall.

rules.title: Donor-pool eligibility criteria
rules.logic: Control donor pools must apply the Table A1 jurisdiction, ecoregion, policy-environment, land-tenure and distance criteria, with optional registered-AFOLU-project exclusion; included geospatial datasets must be no coarser than 30 x 30 m and at least as fine as project plots.

rules.title: Control-unit size constraint
rules.logic: After donor-pool delineation, control units must be non-overlapping, equal-sized, and within plus or minus 20% of the mean project-plot size.

rules.title: Historic matching covariates
rules.logic: Control/project matching must include stocking-index covariates from at least three historic time points, including one between t=-10 and -8, one between t=-8 and -1, and t=0.

rules.title: k-nearest-neighbor matching
rules.logic: Control plots must be matched using k-nearest-neighbor optimal matching without replacement; k is selected by the proponent and remains constant for each project-plot match for the project lifetime.

rules.title: Control matching weights
rules.logic: The k controls with lowest multivariate distance are selected and assigned inverse-distance relative weights that sum to 1 under Equation A1.

rules.title: Stocking-index monitoring
rules.logic: SI must minimize seasonal variability, be monitored at least annually, use a metric demonstrably correlated with carbon stocks, and use the same ex-post metric for project and control plots unless a qualifying harmonized replacement is adopted.

rules.title: De minimis significance procedure
rules.logic: If combined optional-pool and GHG impact is below 5% of expected removals all may be excluded; otherwise include ranked sources through at least 95% and exclude the remainder only if residual combined impact is also below 5% of total removals. Leakage is never part of this de minimis test.

rules.title: Changed-sampling uncertainty procedure
rules.logic: When an area-based inventory approach changes, uncertainty must be calculated across the independent first interval and correlated second interval using Equations A11-A16.

rules.logic: For the performance benchmark, remote sensing is used to estimate relative stock change between project and control plots rather than to directly estimate reportable carbon stocks; removal accounting remains dependent on direct field measurement under Section 8.

rules.title: Match-quality threshold
rules.logic: Overall project/control matching is valid only where SDM for every matching covariate is less than or equal to 0.25; otherwise donor-pool radius or k are iteratively adjusted.

rules.title: Control-plot invalidation and replacement
rules.logic: At monitoring, invalid controls are removed, replacements drawn from the donor pool and control weights recalculated to sum to 1.

rules.title: Benchmark time-series minimum sample
rules.logic: Benchmark time series must include t=0 and t plus prior verifications; matched sets missing time-t SI are excluded; at least 30 project plots are required.

rules.title: Z-test significance threshold
rules.logic: Absolute Z equal to or above 1.96 means project and control stocking-index slopes are significantly different.

rules.title: Performance benchmark pathway
rules.logic: If absolute Z is below 1.96 PBt is 1; if absolute Z is at least 1.96 PBt is calculated by Equation A8; an insignificant or negative control slope is set to zero.

rules.title: Benchmark procedure documentation
rules.logic: All benchmark-establishment steps and all project/control plot locations must be documented in the project description and monitoring plan sufficiently to be repeated and validated.

rules.title: Project-plot construction and sampling
rules.logic: For each annual cohort, project plots must be equal-sized contiguous non-overlapping units of 0.01-10 ha with at least 75% inside the project boundary, and at least 30 representative project plots must be randomly sampled overall.

rules.title: Donor-pool eligibility criteria
rules.logic: Control donor pools must apply the Table A1 jurisdiction, ecoregion, policy-environment, land-tenure and distance criteria, with optional registered-AFOLU-project exclusion; included geospatial datasets must be no coarser than 30 x 30 m and at least as fine as project plots.

rules.title: Control-unit size constraint
rules.logic: After donor-pool delineation, control units must be non-overlapping, equal-sized, and within plus or minus 20% of the mean project-plot size.

rules.title: Historic matching covariates
rules.logic: Control/project matching must include stocking-index covariates from at least three historic time points, including one between t=-10 and -8, one between t=-8 and -1, and t=0.

rules.title: k-nearest-neighbor matching
rules.logic: Control plots must be matched using k-nearest-neighbor optimal matching without replacement; k is selected by the proponent and remains constant for each project-plot match for the project lifetime.

rules.title: Control matching weights
rules.logic: The k controls with lowest multivariate distance are selected and assigned inverse-distance relative weights that sum to 1 under Equation A1.

rules.title: Stocking-index monitoring
rules.logic: SI must minimize seasonal variability, be monitored at least annually, use a metric demonstrably correlated with carbon stocks, and use the same ex-post metric for project and control plots unless a qualifying harmonized replacement is adopted.

rules.title: De minimis significance procedure
rules.logic: If combined optional-pool and GHG impact is below 5% of expected removals all may be excluded; otherwise include ranked sources through at least 95% and exclude the remainder only if residual combined impact is also below 5% of total removals. Leakage is never part of this de minimis test.

rules.title: Changed-sampling uncertainty procedure
rules.logic: When an area-based inventory approach changes, uncertainty must be calculated across the independent first interval and correlated second interval using Equations A11-A16.
